    Assign AQI categories and colors to a pollutant grid

    map_colors.Rd

    Classifies pollutant concentrations according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Air Quality Index (AQI) breakpoints and assigns a color to each grid cell for visualization.

    Usage

    map_colors(grid, pollutant)

    Arguments

    grid

    An sf object containing a pollutant concentration field named value.

    pollutant

    Character. Pollutant name. Supported pollutants are "PM2.5", "PM10", "CO", "SO2", "NO2" and "O3".

    Value

    The input sf object with two additional columns: category and color.

    Details

    Two new columns are added to the input grid:

    category

    AQI category assigned according to the pollutant concentration.

    color

    Hexadecimal color associated with the AQI category.

    AQI breakpoints follow the U.S. EPA Air Quality Index.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# grid must be an sf object containing
# a pollutant concentration column named "value"

colored_grid <- map_colors(
  grid = pollutant_grid,
  pollutant = "PM2.5"
)
} # }
